description: ROS 2 (Jazzy / Humble) Python node package. ament_python build, rclpy, a minimal cmd_vel publisher + /odom subscriber, and a launch file. For mobile robots, manipulator arms, Nav2 stacks, and any robotics product where Python is the glue between drivers and planners.

buildHints.whenToUse: Attach for any ROS 2 Python node — mobile robots, manipulators, sensor bridges, Nav2 lifecycle nodes. Pick this over ros2-node-rust unless the prompt specifically asks for Rust / rclrs or hard-realtime.
firstSteps: Install ROS 2 Jazzy (24.04) or Humble (22.04): follow https://docs.ros.org/en/{{rosDistro}}/Installation.html
Place this package inside a colcon workspace at src/{{packageName}} (the folder containing package.xml)
source install/setup.bash before running ros2 run / ros2 launch — the overlay does NOT chain automatically
gotchas: rclpy is not installable from pip — it ships with the ROS 2 binary distribution. pip install rclpy will fail. Source /opt/ros/{{rosDistro}}/setup.bash so the apt-installed rclpy is on PYTHONPATH.
ROS_DOMAIN_ID isolates DDS traffic between developers on the same LAN. Default 0 means everyone on the subnet sees your topics — set export ROS_DOMAIN_ID=42 (1-232) per workstation.

RMW middleware matters: Jazzy defaults to rmw_fastrtps_cpp, Humble also supports rmw_cyclonedds_cpp. Mixing middlewares across nodes causes silent discovery failures — align RMW_IMPLEMENTATION across all terminals.
Don't forget to source install/setup.bash after every colcon build — ROS overlays are not automatic like nvm/pyenv.
setup.py entry_points['console_scripts'] is the ONLY way `ros2 run <pkg> <script>` finds executables in ament_python. Missing entry_points = missing scripts, no warning.
launch files must live under share/{{packageName}}/launch after install — data_files in setup.py maps them. If launch files aren't found, inspect install/{{packageName}}/share/{{packageName}}/launch.

QoS profiles matter: /odom is typically BEST_EFFORT + VOLATILE, /tf_static is RELIABLE + TRANSIENT_LOCAL. Mismatched QoS between pub/sub = silent drop. Use rclpy.qos.QoSPresetProfiles.SENSOR_DATA for lidar/IMU, SYSTEM_DEFAULT for /cmd_vel.
resource/{{packageName}} is a mandatory empty marker file — ament uses it to register the package with the index. Deleting it breaks `ros2 pkg list`.
Multi-robot setups: namespace each node with `__ns:=/robot1` and remap topics with `topic:=/robot1/cmd_vel`. Hard-coded absolute topics ('/cmd_vel') break multi-robot.
Nav2 lifecycle nodes require manual state transitions. A plain Node subclass won't participate in bt_navigator — inherit from LifecycleNode and wire on_configure/on_activate if integrating with Nav2.
